content.description: one sentence stating the resolved answer

datum_epoch.description: the epoch where the horizontal datum is frame-based

horizontal_datum.description: the horizontal datum (and, where frame-based, the realisation) the site coordinate was expressed in

logged_bores_within_radius.description: how many of those carry a lithology log

nearest_bore_distance_m.description: distance from the project site coordinate to the nearest registered bore within the radius

nearest_bore_drilled_depth_m.description: total drilled depth of the nearest logged bore

nearest_bore_rock_depth_m.description: shallowest `depth_top_m` of an interval whose `MajorLithCode` is in the rock allowlist, in the nearest logged bore; null means no rock evidenced, and null is a first-class answer

nearest_logged_bore_distance_m.description: distance to the nearest bore that carries a log

nearest_logged_bore_id.description: the source register's `bore_id` for the nearest logged bore

project.description: the tenant project whose site coordinate the answer is about

radius_m.description: the search radius the counts and distances were computed at

register_state.description: the state register the answer came from

resolver_version.description: which resolver/method version produced the answer

rock_lith_scheme.description: the code list/edition the lithology code belongs to (NGIS `MajorLithCode`; AS 1726:2017 / AGS 4.2 / DIGGS for other sources)

source.description: the register and vintage the answer was resolved from (e.g. the NGIS NSW extract)
